g.text: Independent USB power only. J_EVM pin 2 (5V) NC. No DUT supply on carrier.

g.desc: Independent USB power only. J_EVM pin 2 (5V) NC. No DUT supply on carrier.

g.text: LED1-5 GP4-8. INA229 SPI0 GP16-19. SD SPI1 GP12-15.
